forecasts.event: OpenAI makes Astra available in some limited form and publishes its system card.
forecasts.rule: A release plus card count; another preparation update does not.
forecasts.evidence_request: Versioned release and system card; compare allowed scope and monitoring claims.

forecasts.event: MCP publishes a new or revised formal proposal or working-group deliverable on agent identity/delegation or asynchronous tasks/events.
forecasts.rule: Require a dated artifact after September 19; the current roadmap alone does not count. Do not infer ratification or universal adoption.
forecasts.evidence_request: Formal dated proposal or deliverable; compare actor, permission and event schemas.

forecasts.event: Anthropic names another embedded evaluator and describes at least its intended access or test scope.
forecasts.rule: A named organization plus scope count; a generic partnership announcement does not.
forecasts.evidence_request: Named evaluator, access and scope; assess independence of evidence genesis.

forecasts.event: A frontier lab and an outside evaluator publish a new independent verification of agent-monitoring effectiveness with an action denominator and capture scope.
forecasts.rule: A named evaluator or self-reported coverage alone does not count.
forecasts.evidence_request: Outside-run evaluation with action denominator, capture scope and missed paths.

forecasts.event: At least one substantive follow-up on the 2026 evaluation containment incidents publishes findings about boundaries, egress, or monitoring.
forecasts.rule: A concrete postmortem or external review counts; a general reassurance does not.
forecasts.evidence_request: New dated findings on boundary, egress or monitoring; derive a planted fault.

forecasts.event: No deployed frontier model publishes an independently verified, complete document-by-document training-input inventory.
forecasts.rule: One such inventory with a credible completeness audit falsifies the forecast. A public summary or output inspection does not count.
forecasts.evidence_request: Input-time inventory plus independent completeness audit; absence needs a bounded search at window end.
